title: Wake After Sleep Onset (WASO)
alternateFormula: WASO = TRT − initial sleep latency − TST
lesson: Wake after sleep onset is the wake time occurring after sleep has begun. Using report components, subtract total sleep time from the sleep period, or subtract initial sleep latency and total sleep time from total recording time.
memoryClue: WASO is wake after sleep starts—not the wake before sleep onset.
coachBobNote: If your answer accidentally includes initial sleep latency, you calculated total wake time rather than WASO.

workedExample.prompt: The sleep period is 430 minutes and TST is 385 minutes. Find WASO.

guided.prompt: TRT 480 min, sleep latency 20 min, TST 405 min. Find WASO.

commonErrors.message: That includes initial sleep latency. WASO begins only after sleep onset.

guided.prompt: Sleep period 420 min, TST 370 min. Find WASO.
